# authwise_providers (Data Source)

A way people sign in to a realm: username and password, a magic link, passkeys, a social or enterprise IdP, or SAML. `config` comes from the matching config data source. This data source lists every one under a parent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `realm_id` (String) Parent identifier `realm_id`; overrides the provider default.
- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `providers` (Attributes List) Every provider under the parent, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--providers))

<a id="nestedatt--providers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `providers`

Read-Only:

- `config` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `name` (String) Full resource name.
- `provider_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `provider_type` (String)
- `trust_upstream_amr` (Boolean)
- `upstream_acr_map` (Map of String)
